label: Mailbox Chat
description: REST and WebSocket mailbox relay server for workbench-driven agent coordination, bridging, and puppeting.
summary: Expose mailbox_chat through the workbench web proxy, then use REST APIs for status, connector/mailbox config, and lifecycle control.

files.description: Primary runtime secrets and endpoint/token settings.
Optional declarative connector/mailbox config loaded at startup.
Optional connector overrides. Primary connector definitions live in presence-*.json files.
Plugin manifest; includes the embedded server_builtin_agents index.
Optional durable mailbox metadata and aliases.
System builtin agent index. Presence files in the same directory are auto-discovered.
SNET Mattermost UUID/name resolver cache file.
ws_collab compatibility metadata (mailboxes, configs, agent properties).

steps: Start mailbox-server on 127.0.0.1:46667 (or set MAILBOX_RELAY_PORT for a different port).
Ensure web_proxy mounts /mailbox_chat to this server (plugin-init entry below).
If MAILBOX_RELAY_TOKEN is set, supply Authorization: Bearer <token> for protected REST routes.
Remove the /mailbox_chat web_proxy mount request if workbench should no longer route to this relay.

plugin-init.description: Redirect /mailbox_chat to the mailbox_chat REST/WebSocket relay.

plugin-lifecycle.note: mailbox_chat runs as its own standalone REST/WS server. Workbench communicates through /mailbox_chat via web_proxy and can puppet/operate it with the plugin-api routes below.

status.description: Relay and adapter status for health checks and control-plane visibility.

restart.description: Request in-process restart (mailbox-server-loop relaunches the process).

shutdown.description: Request graceful relay shutdown (loop exits without relaunch).

plugin-api.note: These routes target the mailbox_chat REST server mounted through web_proxy; restart/shutdown require MAILBOX_RELAY_TOKEN when configured.

server_builtin_agents.description: Embedded builtin agent index for mailbox_chat system agents.
